research_result.description: Vercel is a cloud platform for frontend deployment, hosting, and developer infrastructure providing extensive REST APIs and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up self-serve for a free Hobby account and create access tokens via user/team settings or exchange codes via OAuth 2.0. Deployments on Vercel can also authenticate automatically using Vercel OIDC tokens.

evidence.claim: Vercel provides a REST API covering deployments, access groups, AI gateway, domains, DNS, environment variables, and more.
Authentication for Vercel REST API uses access tokens sent via the Authorization header, or exchanged via OAuth 2.0.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: To use Vercel REST API, you need to authenticate with an access token that contains the necessary scope. You can then provide the API token through the Authorization header.

evidence.claim: Vercel Connect SDK supports OIDC token authentication for running deployments and access tokens passed as Bearer tokens.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: A running Vercel deployment authenticates with its OIDC token.

evidence.claim: Developers can create a self-serve free account with Hobby, Pro, or Enterprise plans available.
